Corollary
[bounded curvature, diameter, volume finiteness]

Source: petersen:page-0447 ↗ lem:pet-ch11-cheeger-injectivity-radius-lemma ↗ thm:pet-ch11-convergence-theorem-riemannian-geometry 1. ch11:11.4.10With $n\ge 2$ and $K,D,v>0$, closed Riemannian $n$-manifolds satisfying $|\sec |\le K$, $\diam \le D$, $\vol \ge v$ is precompact in the $C^{1,\alpha }$ topology for every $\alpha \in (0,1)$, and in particular contains only finitely many diffeomorphism types.
